author: mah813

title: Phenomenal Tour Experience
text: This tour was well worth the money spent. We saw everything we wanted to in Barcelona. Our guide had detailed knowledge of the city. She took into account that we both used a cane. She was a cautious driver and seemed comfortable driving around the city as well as providing explanations. This tour was the highlight of our 24 day cruise. It was an indepth experience and I highly recommend this company to all. We loved our time with our driver. She has given us beautiful memories of Barcelona.
author: kathleenmaryb

title: Wonderful day in Barcelona
text: An incredible full day of private touring in Barcelona. The tour operator arranged all of the tickets (Park Guell, Casa Mila, Casa Batllo). Our wonderful guide, Jordin, suggested a great lunch stop. We saw so much but never felt rushed.
author: U1388RZdebbieb

title: Wonderful experience!
text: Wonderful experience! Aurelio and Juana were very easy to communicate with and coordinate the tours. Christian was the guide and he provided a wonderful experience - he provided a lot of context and history that really helped understand the sights. Highly recommend!
author: Paradise499861

title: Great tour company
text: What a great experience! We were a group of four disembarking from a cruise and wanted a tour of Barcelona and to be picked up from the cruise port. Well we picked a great company for the tour. They were waiting for us after we exited the port and picked us up in a very nice large van. Marta was wonderful, helped us with our luggage and took us on a four hour tour around the city. She was very flexible and understanding when we needed a coffee break, snack and restroom visit. We would highly recommend their services. They are a family owned business and we like to use local businesses.
author: cheryld148

title: A Great experience and comfortable
text: After doing a lot of research I choose this company as it provided the perfect experience for my mom as she is 80 and has limited mobility. Christian our guide was amazing and made us feel like family as he showed us the highlights  around this beautiful city. He was very knowledgeable with the history of each site of the city. I loved that they were able to pick us up and drop us off at the hotel. I would definitely recommend this company to anyone traveling with a family member with limited mobility. If i ever come to Barcelona again I would definitely use this company.
author: markgd2019

title: Great experience with private tours that catered to our special needs!
text:
We took 3 separate, private tours and had a wonderful time on all three. We did a Barcelona Highlights tour with airport pickup or first day. The next day, an all day excursion l to Costa Brava and Girona. Our last day was a tour with Tony to Montserrat. Each guide was friendly, professional and very knowledgeable. Barcelona Day Tours made our brief stay in Barcelona super convenient and memorable.  All pickups were on time and the vehicles were spotless and comfortable. 

Our many thanks to Christian (the German), Marta and Antonio! You guys are the best!
author: Stay528686

title: Great 1st day
text: Great tour, our day started with a flawless port pickup. Our guide Elena was the best, providing lots of information about Barcelona itself dining recommendations , places to visit in the neighborhoods of Born and Gothic areas, The tour is a great 1st day overview of Barcelona while visiting Park Gaudi , the Familia providing. If you are lucky enough to Elena as your guide you in for a special experience!
author: P4871COjimr

title: A perfect private tour in Barcelona
text:
Our experience was absolutely incredible from start to finish. Our driver, Chris, was amazing. He ensured that we got to see and do everything on our list despite a huge race that closed half the city streets and a planned protest. 

Chris was so knowledgeable about Barcelona and shared with us so much history and fun facts throughout the day. He navigated the city with such ease (again, despite half the streets being closed!) and communicated very clearly with us the whole day. We had no trouble finding him at pickup spots. title: Accommodating, Great Communications
text:
My first thought is their accommodation - we stayed at a hotel that is not within their regular locations, but they arranged a pickup at our hotel, keeping us informed at the time of the booking, reminder when getting close, and the day before. We always knew what to expect. 
The tour guide was knowledgeable, pointing out information for places we passed while driving, and then when stopped at locations. Our group was small enough (maybe 12 to 15??) that everyone was able to keep up with the tour guide's information. 
Enjoyable ride around Barcelona.
